# A read at a negative constant offset is left alone when an index it reads is a
# negative constant: the one at the lowest index the loop visits, with a constant
# start (a[i-1] over 0..n-1, whichever way the loop counts, and over a range of a
# slice), or every one, with a constant limit (a[i-16] in a loop that stops before
# 16). The scalar loop panics when it reaches that index, and the vector loop would
# index at a negative constant, which does not compile. The start and limit may be
# literals, named constants or constant expressions (see offset_negative_constant.txt
# for the loops that are rewritten). A read at a positive constant offset that
# pushes a constant start or limit past the largest int is left alone too, since the
# emitted code would add them.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

import "math"

func EveryIndexNegative(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-16] + 1
	}
}

func FarBelow(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-20] * a[i]
	}
}

func FirstIndexNegative(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
	}
}

const s0, lim = 0, 16

func NamedLimit(dst, a []int32, k int) {
	for i := k; i < lim; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-20] + 1
	}
}

func NamedStart(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := s0; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
	}
}

func ExpressionStart(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := 1 - 1; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
	}
}

func NamedStartCopy(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := s0; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1]
	}
}

func CountingDownToZero(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 15; i >= 0; i-- {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] + 1
	}
}

func RangeOverSlice(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] + 1
	}
}

func LimitPastLargest(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < math.MaxInt64; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+1] + 1
	}
}

func StartPastLargest(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := math.MaxInt64 - 1; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+2] + 1
	}
}
